title: Mouse Without Borders broken on .102 release

judgment.rationale: The sole comment explicitly links #50795 and reproduces its exact 0.102.3001.0 `untrusted-signature` SettingsSync exception, certificate pair, failed key/pairing operations, and 0.101.2362.0 workaround. Keep primary investigation in #50795; do not create a competing fix.
evidence: The original report says MWB cannot generate a key or pair on 0.102 from Microsoft Store and that 0.101 works.

The commenter confirms the exact `untrusted-signature` rejection on 0.102.3001.0, the same signer thumbprints as #50795 assigned to opposite executables, unsuccessful key/config/service-mode resets, and a working downgrade.

Upstream main 9227a8497750 compares trusted leaf signer certificates exactly, matching #50795's established rejection: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/9227a8497750c257a0682b53c556d07f48ed8ff3/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI.Library/Utilities/NamedPipePeerVerification.cs#L265-L334
judgment.recommended_action: Treat as duplicate coverage of #50795 and keep the fix and validation in that primary issue

fix_assessment.rationale: No separate code fix applies to this duplicate report; the underlying release signer mismatch remains tracked in #50795. This does not claim that the underlying PowerToys bug needs no correction.

issue_context.summary: A short duplicate report confirms the same 0.102.3001.0 MWB signer mismatch already documented in #50795.
known_information: The issue reports key generation and pairing failure on the 0.102 Microsoft Store build, with 0.101 reported as working.
Its commenter supplies the same `untrusted-signature` exception and certificate identities described in #50795, plus a successful downgrade workaround.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is not only a generic pairing report: its comment explicitly links #50795 and supplies the same SettingsSync rejection and signer identities. Keep #50795 as the primary tracking issue rather than proposing a competing change.
initial_investigation: Refreshed the full body and only comment, including the #50795 and 0.101.2362.0 links; no attachment is present.

Compared the exception and signer identities with #50795 and the shared upstream policy. The primary issue contains the original report, detailed evidence, current-release confirmation, and correction direction: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/50795
